subject: Alcohol Compliance Check Violations
overview: The commission adjudicated six liquor license violations resulting from police compliance checks and approved several license requests. Five businesses received warnings and one-year probation for selling alcohol to minors, while one hearing was tabled due to the licensee's absence.

items.title: Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the May 15 and June 26, 2024, meetings with minor amendments to the June record.

items.title: Snappy Patties Hours Extension
items.summary: Approved an extension of hours for Snappy Patties to remain open until 1:00 AM on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays.

items.title: D1 Soccer One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for soccer events at Hormel Stadium on August 17 and 31, 2024, following discussions regarding noise management and parking lot security.

items.title: Compliance Check Procedure Overview
items.summary: The Medford Police Department and Health Department presented the methodology used for citywide alcohol compliance stings involving underage buyers.

items.title: Violation: Medford Wine and Spirits
items.summary: Issued a warning and one-year probation to Medford Wine and Spirits for selling a case of hard seltzer to a 16-year-old minor.

items.title: Violation: Hillside Wine and Spirits
items.summary: Issued a warning and one-year probation to Hillside Wine and Spirits after a clerk sold a 12-pack of seltzer to a 16-year-old without checking identification.

items.title: Violation: Blue Fuji
items.summary: Tabled the violation hearing for Blue Fuji until September due to the licensee's failure to appear.

items.title: Violation: Hyatt Place
items.summary: Issued a warning and one-year probation to Hyatt Place after a bartender served hard cider to minors and advised them to hide their ages from management.

items.title: Violation: Real Gusto
items.summary: Issued a warning and one-year probation to Real Gusto for an underage sale by a server-in-training who failed to verify age despite asking for identification.

items.title: Violation: Deep Cuts
items.summary: Issued a warning and one-year probation to Deep Cuts for serving tequila-based drinks to minors during a period when door security was not yet active.

items.title: New One-Day License Application
items.summary: Approved a redesigned one-day license application form that explicitly includes a section for entertainment details and music.
